description: Concentration of a lyophilized powder after adding a diluent volume, in mg/mL and mcg/mL. Optionally gives the volume in mL and µL that holds a wanted amount. For laboratory calculations only.

diluent_ml.description: Volume of diluent added, in mL. Must be greater than 0.

powder_amount.description: Mass of powder in the vial. Must be greater than 0.

wanted_amount.description: Optional mass you want to draw out. Must be greater than 0.

name: reconstitution_concentration
title: Reconstitution concentration
